source_blob_semantics: source_blob is the original Git blob at source_revision, before this documentation update; it does not claim to hash revised front-door content. The final PR diff records those edits.
enumeration: git ls-tree -rz --full-tree SOURCE_REVISION; select every tracked path whose basename contains readme case-insensitively

coverage.untracked_readmes_and_external_cache_rea: Excluded from tracked-repository enumeration; consult audit source catalogs.
coverage.workflow_skill: tools/skills/uor-project-workflow/SKILL.md is an active instruction entrypoint, not a README; maintained separately by the lead.

disposition_policy.current_front_doors: Update name, native-core and capability boundaries, canonical navigation, and artifact/research discovery. Keep technical contracts and historical evidence scoped.
disposition_policy.historical_import_vendor: Preserve source names, licenses, commands and mathematical/proof statuses; use current research/audit wrappers to explain relevance. No bulk search-and-replace inside imported source.
disposition_policy.authority: docs/integration/project-track.md owns the owner-directed plan; docs/integration/current-state.md owns accepted implementation and evidence pointers; live GitHub owns delivery state.
disposition_policy.verification: Path/blob/classification census only. No build, model execution, proof checking or remote link validation performed by this inventory.
